title: As-Salam and the Kind Word
summary: ﴿وَقُولُوا لِلنَّاسِ حُسْنًا﴾ (Al-Baqarah: 83 — interpretation of the meaning: “And speak to people good [words].”) Teach your child as-salam (the greeting of peace) upon entering and gratitude upon receiving; the kind word is sadaqah (charity), and planting it early shapes a beautiful heart and tongue.
try_this: This week: Train your child to give as-salam when entering the house, and be the qudwah (example) yourself every time.
reflection_prompts: Has your child started giving as-salam?
